title: dank-tank
hint: Click for details · right-click to refresh
pace_legend: ↑ ahead of pace · → on track · ↓ under

show_codex.label: Show Codex
show_codex.description: Add all rate-limit windows reported by your Codex plan.

show_antigravity.label: Show Antigravity
show_antigravity.description: Add Gemini and third-party 5-hour and weekly quotas from AGY.

show_opencode.label: Show OpenCode Go
show_opencode.description: Add the 5-hour, weekly and monthly limits of your OpenCode Go plan.

show_spend.label: Show credit spend
show_spend.description: Add extra-usage spending, when credits are enabled on the account.

refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to re-read usage. The command caches for 60s, so lower values mostly re-read that cache.

warn_at.label: Warn at (%)
warn_at.description: Percentage at which the number turns amber.

warn_color.label: Warning color
warn_color.description: Color for percentages past the warning threshold. Themes disagree on which accent means caution, so this one is fixed rather than a palette role.

alert_at.label: Alert at (%)
alert_at.description: Percentage at which the number turns red.
